name: model-router
description: Routes prompts and subagents to a cheaper or stronger model by what they ask

lightModel.title: Light model
lightModel.description: Model id for routine commands and read-only subagents

maxMessages.title: Max messages
maxMessages.description: Stop auto-routing the main thread past this many messages (a switch rebuilds the prompt cache)

lightAgents.title: Light subagents
lightAgents.description: Comma-separated subagent types sent to the light model

routeMainThread.title: Route main thread
routeMainThread.description: Pick a model per prompt on the main thread

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents
routeSubagents.description: Send light subagents to the light model
